about: SuperForge Dungeons actor sprites. anchor_x / anchor_y are the pixel the figure's ROOT (the ground point between the feet) lands on in the box, identical in every direction; draw a frame at (ground_x - anchor_x, ground_y - anchor_y). foot_rows are the MEASURED lowest model row per frame: they differ from anchor_y by the stance's depth separation (the near foot is lower in a side view), which is geometry, not drift. Written by sheets.py (13 §4).
